verdict.rationale: Agent Studio documents knowledge data that grounds the agent, explicitly including Help Center content, FAQs, and policies, and Insights shows which knowledge sources an answer used. That establishes a first-party knowledge-grounding capability, but the evidence never describes automatic ingestion or connectors, and covers only part of the source types the story names. Ghostwriter's upload of SOPs and transcripts generates journeys, not knowledge, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: documented automatic ingestion or sync connectors for help centers, ingestion of docs, past tickets and internal wikis, evidence that no manual re-authoring is needed, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the agent ingests my help center, docs, past tickets, and internal wikis as knowledge sources without manual re-authoring

citations.quote: View, manage, and edit knowledge data such as Help Center content, FAQs, and policies that ground your agent.
view knowledge sources, systems accessed, and more.
